title: Retire completed proof-case job bundles and standardize intra-Lyra handoff protocol
summary: 4 proof-case job bundles (JOB-TM-001/002, JOB-DEL-001, JOB-GOV-001) are complete but not archived. Intra-Lyra handoff protocol not formalized.
body: Jobs Review (2026-03-16): JOB-TM-001, JOB-TM-002, JOB-DEL-001, JOB-GOV-001 are done proof-case bundles not in canonical job registry and not archived. Handoff protocol not formalized as governance artifact. Required: archive done bundles; formalize handoff protocol as governance artifact; add done-jobs index.
proposed_action: Archive done job bundles and publish intra-Lyra handoff protocol governance artifact
